name: Sequoia Adelaide Hills
insider_take: Hidden among the rolling vineyards and eucalyptus forests of the Adelaide Hills, this boutique retreat offers a perfect escape just 20 minutes from the city buzz.
whats_special: Sequoia Adelaide Hills sits in the heart of Australia's coolest wine region, where the elevation creates perfect conditions for Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. The hotel's location in Crafers puts you at the doorstep of Mount Lofty Summit - South Australia's highest peak - offering panoramic views stretching to the coast. The surrounding Adelaide Hills is famous for its German heritage, with charming towns like Hahndorf featuring authentic bakeries and craft breweries.
pro_tip: Visit during autumn (March-May) when the hills transform into a tapestry of golden colors, and many wineries offer special harvest experiences you can't get any other time of year.
dont_miss: A sunrise visit to Mount Lofty Summit for breathtaking 360-degree views, wine tasting at nearby Shaw + Smith or Bird in Hand wineries, and exploring the historic German village of Hahndorf with its traditional architecture and artisan shops. The Cleland Wildlife Park is also just minutes away, where you can hand-feed kangaroos and cuddle koalas.
pros: Stunning Adelaide Hills location with panoramic valley views
Luxurious spa facilities and wellness treatments
Close proximity to renowned wine regions and cellar doors
Exceptional fine dining restaurant with local produce
cons: Remote hillside location requires vehicle transportation
